mythology: Venerated in the Ashtadasha Shakti Peetha tradition. Historical fabric and devotional narratives are distinguished in the reference notes.
pilgrimage_significance: The ruins preserve the memory of Sharada worship and a historic centre of learning. The modern Teetwal shrine is a separate site.
historical_notes: Present-condition study of the roofless stone sanctuary, raised platform, enclosure and 63-step approach documented by the archaeology authority. Photographic reference guides masonry and doorway massing. Approximate geometry is not a measured replica; no historic roof or lost idol has been invented.
